title: Fix pagination drift in billing
why: Page boundaries shift when rows are inserted mid-scroll.

title: Add a strict mode to the config parser
why: Typos in config keys are ignored silently and defaults win.
what: Two parts. First reject unknown keys in src/config/parse.js; check that part with `npm run test:parser`, which passes. Then add the --strict flag to src/cli.js; check that part with `npm run test:cli`, which passes.

title: Cache search suggestions
why: Typing in the search box hits the database on every key.
what: Memoize suggestion lookups in src/search/suggest.js for sixty seconds. Run `npm test`; every test passes.
